name.ja_romaji: Nazo no Hikōshokubutsu ha Jitsuzai Shita!!

requirement.en: Place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.

effect.en: Add 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Attribute Plant Type monster from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or higher WIND Attribute Plant Type monster from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, you can only attack with Plant Type monsters.
